title: The Proliferation of Illicit Drones in Southeast Asia
gist: Beyond conflict use, Southeast Asia is seeing a steady rise in illicit use of commercial-off-the-shelf consumer drones. Short excerpt.

themes.theme: Illicit drone use in Southeast Asia

insights.claim: Drones were widely used in Southeast Asian conflicts including the 2017 Marawi siege, the Myanmar conflict since 2021 and the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict last year.
insights.speaker: Rueben Dass
insights.so_what: Regional demand for counter-drone capabilities is rising.

insights.claim: The region has seen a steady increase in illicit use of drones, primarily commercial-off-the-shelf consumer drones, beyond conflict settings.
insights.speaker: Rueben Dass
insights.so_what: Points to regulatory and counter-UAS demand tied to consumer drones.
